windows.label: Human
windows.text: It can go either way, but often the man wants to keep it undefined while the woman wants commitment, partly because she’s the one risking pregnancy. Whoever keeps it undefined gets the fun without the responsibility.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: People still get pregnant and attached, though, whether or not anybody named the relationship, and the one keeping it undefined still ends up with the existential void another superficial fix creates. Doomscrolling entertains you too.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
You can know somebody for twenty years and then discover on the first night that the polarity isn’t there. Touch or smell can feel wrong, or your desire levels or kinks don’t fit. Maybe one person is sexually shut down, or the bodies just don’t connect.
Some of those things might get better if both partners are committed to helping each other through it. Sometimes bad sexual fit still feels like, “Let’s just be friends!”

windows.label: Human
windows.text: A peer can give another angle.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
Your partner is also usually trying to keep you, so they have an ulterior motive that a peer counselor hopefully does not.
I recommend peer counseling outside the couple: if my partner is the only person I bring all my pain to, she also ends up carrying whatever I do when I still don’t understand it.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I also have to deal with what happens in my body: my mind may understand that my partner is going through something difficult and that I don’t have to be dragged down with her, but my body still feels dragged down, fragile, and sensitive. My breathing gets shallow, and it becomes extremely hard to feel okay while she is in pain.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Crying also contains a type of automatic erratic breathwork. Breathwork is one of the easiest ways I know to calm down. Reduced breathing or the Buteyko method is especially useful to me when my partner is getting me upset and flustered with drama. Sometimes she’s deliberately trying to do that, and other times it’s hard to tell. I explain more of the body-based options in my Somatic Modalities guide.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Meditation is also helpful, but for most people, I would still put inner-child reparenting, peer counseling, and body-based work first or make them primary meditation targets. Many people say they cannot meditate or have not gotten to that stage yet, and meditation without grounding in those approaches can easily be a road into spiritual bypassing.

r14-muses.headline: Human Written

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
In ordinary life, I sometimes think of the woman as the engine and myself as the steering wheel, and I get motivation from her. She is the life force. She brings inspiration, beauty, intuition, creativity, and this feeling that life is worth doing.
I help give it direction and make it operational.
I find the intuitive mind incredibly sexy, because I can’t fully follow it. During sex, some of the most “womanly” women I’ve loved have gone through psychic experiences, memories that felt like past lives, and things I had no idea how to explain. One time, Bee said she almost got enlightened, but I came too fast.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Woops...

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
Key could sometimes start talking and somehow teleport me outside the galaxy. I don’t know how else to describe it. Her voice would become so beautiful that I would shed tears that felt super liberating.
Bee could bring out something similar--she could be talking to me for hours on end, but instead of trying to mute her with the TV remote, I felt I was in a timeless dimension of love.
Maybe women are poetry and men are prose.

r14-jeal.headline: AI Detected

windows.label: Human
windows.text: These days, even the brief inkling of attraction to another person becomes almost a sure sign that sexual infidelity is next. (through) She even started hallucinating that I was looking at or talking to other women when I wasn’t.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: So her jealousy was not simply tracking what I was doing in the present.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: More likely it was insecure attachment from childhood trying to justify its continued existence. (through) Maybe he really is neglecting you or wanting to be with someone else.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Maybe the “attention” was one glance and your baseline insecurity inflated it into a threat that it wasn’t. That part should not be projected onto your partner. Every couple has to work out for themselves what actually feels healthy.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I do believe two people can choose sexual exclusivity honestly.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: They can admit that attraction to other people exists and decide not to act on it each day.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I would rather make every attraction possible to mention casually, including the low-stakes ones.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: If only the serious attractions are supposed to be disclosed, each disclosure becomes such a major event that people are less likely to say anything at all.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: A foundational, permanent, exclusive romantic partnership is promised far more often than it is actually lived. In a polyamorous relationship the boundaries might be more negotiable, but that actually means negotiating is required.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: That’s not to say that polyamory is automatically better, because it can be dishonest too.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: These days, I believe it is often a way to cope with an inability to connect deeply with one person, or a way to admit a lack of self-control without necessarily doing the self-development that would make the arrangement ethical.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: If you can’t do monogamy, saying so is still more honest than pretending you can, and sometimes the pretending does more damage than an outside connection would have.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I learned most of this by screwing it up.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Some of it I just thought through, and I’m still not sure about all of it.

r14-labels.headline: Human Written

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Here’s the funny thing many people don’t understand: labels don’t create commitment, but they can still expose whether two people think they’re in the same relationship, which matters a lot. (through) If you’re dishonest, can’t care what happens to another person, or keep turning every relationship into the same disaster, come on.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: You’re not ready.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: You don’t have to be completely healed, but the present-day adult has to be able to parent whatever intimacy wakes up inside you, and responsible enough to deal with an actual child if sex creates one. (through) Here’s a video that can help understand the long process.
